name: Modified Ashworth Scale
description: Clinician-graded scale for spasticity/muscle tone. Scores 0, 1, 1+, 2, 3, 4 (where 1+ is an intermediate grade).
shirleySays: Inter-rater ICC 0.65–0.84 (moderate). No MCID established. Known ceiling/floor effects. Validated in stroke, SCI, TBI, MS, and CP. Most widely used spasticity measure despite ordinal limitations.
